Locking rules for table install, clear and populate outside the migration helper.
Architectural definitions of none, bad, present, huge, leaf, special, protnone, soft dirty and exclusive predicates.
Driver that invokes the validation helpers and overall pass or fail reporting.
Swap entry layout and maximum offset probing beyond observed use.
Accounting counter semantics for table allocations.

findings.text: Provides a destructor for a detached virtual area descriptor that asserts detachment, releases NUMA state, anonymous name and pfnmap tracking state, then returns the descriptor to its dedicated cache.

Harness context observed to carry an address space handle, a virtual area handle, table cursors plus saved base tables for several levels, a user address, normal and none protections, allocated and fixed frame numbers per level, swap and leaf entries, an alignment record and a contiguity marker.

Huge leaf validation at two middle levels proceeds only when architecture mapping support exists and recorded alignment covers the level size, and requires that installing then removing a huge leaf leaves the slot observed as empty.
Top level basic checks require self equality to hold for an entry filled with an arbitrary nonzero pattern.

Clear checks at upper levels require a populated slot before clearing and an empty slot after reread, while populate checks require a pointer to a lower table to avoid the bad entry classification; levels reported as folded are skipped, and the lowest middle level has no folding skip.
Leaf clear validation is skipped without a valid page or cursor, otherwise installing a leaf from the recorded frame and protection then clearing it must leave the reread leaf observed as empty.

Special marking is validated only where the architecture advertises it, and protection none validation requires both the none classification and the present classification to hold for leaves built with the none protection, including the huge middle level variant when transparent huge pages exist.

Soft dirty validation is skipped unless the page table layer advertises support, and otherwise requires that the dirty marker can be set and then cleared on normal entries at two levels and on swap forms, with the leaf swap variant additionally requiring huge and valid softleaf classifications.

Swap validation requires round trip conversion between swap and table forms to preserve identity and swap classification, with the exclusive marker capable of being set and cleared without losing swap identity or spuriously reporting soft dirtiness, and the middle level variant requiring huge and valid softleaf classifications.

Transparent huge page validation is skipped unless the corresponding level is available, and requires that promoting a normal entry to huge yields the transparent huge classification, with the middle level additionally requiring continued huge, present and leaf observation after invalidation on configurations lacking a dedicated invalidate primitive.
Migration entry validation holds the page locked across creation of writable and readable migration forms and releases it afterwards.
Huge TLB basic validation builds a huge leaf from the recorded middle frame and access permissions, then requires dirty and write markers to round trip through their makers and protectors.

Harness lifetime moves from zeroed context through address space and area allocation, construction of nested table levels, fixed frame selection and swap probing, to teardown that frees huge frames, table pages with accounting updates, then area and address space handles.

Fixed frame selection prefers a usable range aligned to the larger middle size, falls back to the smaller middle size, otherwise uses the kernel entry symbol address, masks one address down to each table level, records the achieved alignment, and expects the leaf frame to be valid.
Random address selection yields a page aligned user address within the user range by scaling a random value with the count of user pages.
Several validation helpers have empty compiled variants that perform no action when the associated page table level or feature is unavailable, preserving a uniform call surface across configurations.

Migration validation uses a dedicated allocated frame rather than the frame backing kernel text, because locking the kernel text frame would be problematic, and creation helpers assume the caller already holds the lock.

Leaf install validation performs a data cache maintenance operation for the page plus an ordering barrier before clearing, to avoid leaving an architecture specific page flag set across later reuse on some architectures.
The all ones unsigned long value serves as the sentinel meaning no frame number is recorded for allocated and fixed frames at every level.
Middle level sizes and masks define alignment eligibility for huge validation and derivation of fixed frames per level, with distinct huge page orders for the two middle levels.
Setup reports allocation failures for address space, area and each table level and aborts with an out of memory status.
Pfnmap tracking release does nothing when no context is attached, otherwise it drops the context reference through its release callback and detaches the pointer.

Huge page allocation prefers contiguous allocation for orders beyond the buddy maximum and records contiguity, otherwise uses the buddy allocator within limits, while freeing dispatches on the recorded contiguity marker.
